## Overview

This 2026-09-15 Adyen page is an Android integration chooser for FPX Online Banking Malaysia. It links separate Drop-in and Components child guides plus the main Android Sessions and Advanced integration guides. The page itself gives no method-specific API/SDK version, issuer list, test result, merchant eligibility, or payment outcome. See [[adyen]] and [[adyen-online-payments]].

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in choice is described as an all-in-one UI solution. The Components choice says to use `InstantPaymentComponent` to handle a redirect to FPX Online Banking Malaysia. Those are route descriptions; the child guides govern implementation details.
- The page says to create the main integration before adding FPX Online Banking Malaysia and links Android Drop-in and Components for both Sessions and Advanced flows. A linked flow does not establish that a payment was attempted or completed.

## Detail locators

- Android chooser and child links: pinned raw lines 15–27.
- Main integration prerequisite and four flow links: lines 29–36.
